newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BIRZHU PIPELINE HANDLES MORE OIL IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: BIRZHU PIPELINE HANDLES MORE OIL IN JUNE.

text.p: Lithuania's oil transporter Birzhu Pipelines said on Friday that it transported 1.979 million tonnes of oil products in June compared to 1.954 million tonnes in May.
The finance director of the company Ona Slaniene also told Reuters that 1.206 million tonnes of crude was transported to Ventspils port in June compared to 1.242 million tonnes in May.
The company said it transported 276,000 tonnes of diesel fuel to Ventspils in June compared to 234,000 tonnes in May.
497,000 tonnes of crude was transported to Mazeikiu Nafta in June compared to 477,000 tonnes in May, Slaniene said.
The company reported earlier it transported 5.2 million tonnes of crude and related products in the first quarter of the year and 1.988 million tonnes in April.
Slaniene said that the income of the firm was 7.171 million litas in June compared to 7.123 million litas in May.
She added that the profit of the company in June was 4.9 million litas compared to 4.99 million litas the previous month.
The final profit figures for the first half of the year will be known on July 16, Slaniene said.
The company reported earlier that its net profit for the first quarter of the year was 5.3 million litas and it was targeting a 40 million litas profit for the whole year.

The company is 90 percent state owned and the government said earlier it was planning to merge the company into an oil concern with Mazeikiu Nafta, Butinges Nafta and Lietuvos Kuras and offer it for privatisation.
